breakdown.description: The prompt sets the free-end rotation to zero, even though a cantilever’s free end is generally free to rotate under an end point load.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification uses the standard cantilever slope formula θ = (P * L^2) / (2 * E * I), which correctly accounts for free-end rotation under an end point load. It does not set the free-end rotation to zero as the incomplete prompt incorrectly instructed.

breakdown.description: The prompt treats the bending moment as constant and equal to P L over the entire span, even though the cantilever moment varies linearly from the free end to the fixed end.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification uses the standard cantilever deflection formula δ = (P * L^3) / (3 * E * I), which is derived from the linearly varying bending moment distribution (M(x) = P*(L-x)). It does not treat the moment as constant and equal to P*L over the full span as the incomplete prompt incorrectly instructed.
